job.title: Advanced Scaffolder - Gove NT
job.description:
We are currently seeking experienced Advanced Scaffolders to join an established team on a FIFO project in Nhulunbuy (Gove), Northern Territory.

This opportunity offers competitive hourly rates, a structured FIFO roster and the potential for ongoing work for a suitably qualified and experienced candidate.

Key Responsibilities
  • Erect, modify and dismantle scaffolding structures in accordance with site requirements and Australian Standards
  • Undertake advanced scaffolding activities safely and efficiently
  • Conduct inspections of scaffolding equipment and structures
  • Work collaboratively with site supervisors and other trades
  • Maintain compliance with workplace health and safety procedures and site-specific requirements
Essential Requirements
  • Current Advanced Scaffolding (SA) High Risk Work Licence
  • Demonstrated experience in advanced scaffolding operations
  • Ability to successfully complete a Pre-Employment Medical 
  • Willingness and ability to complete all mandatory site inductions
  • Strong understanding of workplace health and safety practices
  • Availability for an immediate start
APPLY NOW to submit your current resume or email Cecilia at cewatts@goalis.com.au for more details

Applications are welcome from all suitably qualified candidates
